note: atlas-main20 repin (2026-11-27): Atlas main 0.3.20 (boundless-atlas 440b469), asi 7c972767, oop plugin 6afc79b5, script half atlas-main20b-1127 (7ed0c75, pkg=8cda3053). atlas-main18 repin (2026-11-27): Atlas main 0.3.19 (boundless-atlas 91f004e), asi d09ee22f, oop plugin 08f6bb06, script half atlas-main18-1127. atlas-seed-sims-1126: seed-only far Sims P1 (sims-3-modernization docs/361 §6.6; Boundless Atlas branch feature/seed-sims-1126), seven jobs on Sunset Valley (Baseline-SV) in this order: gen (new seed, save Repro-SeedSims-1126, sidecar written after the save by the SaveBracket Post handler) -> reload (status ok, regen match: the population comes back bit for bit from seed + time) -> nomod (the same save without Atlas: plain EA save, no script error; saves Repro-SeedSimsNoMod-1126) -> after-nomod (status ok, regen match) -> travel (France and back: same seed for the home town) -> stale (the no-mod save: stale, seed kept, nothing to repair) -> OFF arm. The jobs depend on each other: run them in order, never --from the middle. P1 creates nothing in the game, so the no-mod job checks only that the save is plain EA. DRY-RUN ONLY: never run. NOT RUNNABLE ON MASTER YET: extraAsi comes with branch feature/atlas-p0-load-1126 (this branch is cut from it). The Atlas pins are built from boundless-atlas feature/seed-sims-1126 0171723 (rebased on main ce7c648, hooked in); a later Atlas commit needs a rebuild and repin (asi sha256, mod-set sha). Scratch saves Repro-SeedSims-1126 and Repro-SeedSimsNoMod-1126 are removed by hand after the run; seed sidecars are deleted by the first step of the gen job (Atlas.SeedSims.CleanAndReload, files <16 hex>.seed.jsonl in ts3native\atlas\ only). 2026-11-27: every job repinned to Atlas main 0.3.15 (boundless-atlas main 212e136, game-copy/atlas-main13/atlas.asi sha256 1a849c2616d58b6494e4ebb0333034df168da93b9e6b210f8ebf3abddfc5a919, mod set game-copy/mod-sets/atlas-main13); new logRequire 'atlas:icalls ready 3'; the repros wait for the settled script half (AtlasNative.Groups log, ready 3, waiting 0) before their first Atlas step. 0.3.15 read-backs (version line, rebase 6 / rebase-4, freeze native 3 and script 0.2.1-fz2, oop client 3 protocol 4, plugin 3) are inferred from the 212e136 source, not seen in a log yet.
